channel.title: mint - news
channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: Why India’s energy security is now caught in Trump’s ‘coercive geopolitics’? Expert weighs in
item.description: India's energy security is at stake amid heightened US sanctions targeting Russian oil imports. Raj Yadav, Assistant Professor at the Centre for Russian and Central Asian Studies, JNU, says legislation imposes economic pressure while India attempts to maintain crucial relations with Russia and US.

item.title: 250 applications, no offers: IIM Kozhikode grad highlights harsh reality of corporate job market in viral post
item.description: Taking to Reddit to seek an “outside perspective,” the frustrated professional highlighted the harsh conditions of the current white-collar job market, where even top-tier degrees struggle to break through the silence.

item.title: UK woman quit a high-paying criminal law career for dog-walking, now earns ₹50,000 a day
item.description: Liz East spent four years in criminal defence law, and most days ended the same way: exhausted, drained, and wondering if this was really her life. She quit — and found something unexpected on the other side.&nbsp;

item.title: Who Was Dhrubajyoti Guha? Indian-origin climber killed in Mt Manaslu avalanche
item.description: Outside his corporate work, Dhrubajyoti Guha was an accomplished ultra-endurance trail runner who had completed 32 UTMB World Series races, including several exceeding 100km.

item.title: Who is Pulkit Mani? Stand-up comedian at centre of Rahul Gandhi-Modi mimicry row
item.description: The Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) slammed the Congress over the event and said the party has turned into 'party of jokers' and ‘circus.’ The saffron party also called Rahul Gandhi ‘Asanskari naraz fufa’ after the controversial event.

item.title: ‘I might not have a job tomorrow’: Man's post on colleague's sudden layoff sparks job security debate
item.description: A Reddit post about a colleague being fired 'on spot' with no warning has sparked a wider conversation about job security, with the poster admitting the sudden exit left him wondering if he could be next — layoffs included, 'even when everything appears to be going normally.'

item.title: Petrol, diesel prices today, September 21: Check rates in Delhi, Mumbai, Bengaluru
item.description: In Mumbai, petrol price stands at ₹111.21 per litre today. No change has been recorded in petrol prices compared to yesterday.

item.title: US-Iran war LIVE Updates: IRGC says it shot down US MQ-1 drone over Strait of Hormuz
item.description: US-Iran war LIVE Updates: Iran has threatened “continuous, effective and painful” attacks on US bases and interests across the region if Washington resumes military action against Tehran, as tensions between the two countries intensify.

item.title: Man Shot by ICE Agent in Austin, Texas, Sparking Mayor’s Ire
item.description: A man shot by an Immigration and Customs Enforcement officer Sunday in Austin, Texas, is in “stable, but serious condition,” in the latest incident tied to the Trump administration’s aggressive push to deport undocumented people.

item.title: Dutch Police Break Up Violent Far-Right Protest in The Hague
item.description: Dutch police broke up a far-right protest of several hundred demonstrators in The Hague after it turned violent on Saturday.

item.title: What time is 60 Minutes on tonight? How to watch Patrick Clancy’s first TV interview on CBS
item.description: Patrick Clancy will give his first TV interview tonight after his ex-wife Lindsay Clancy’s murder trial ended in a mistrial. Here’s when the 60 Minutes interview airs, where to watch it and what to know about the case.

item.title: ‘Gaslit by a king’: Charles Spencer breaks silence after Palace response to his Diana memoir
item.description: Princess Diana’s brother Charles Spencer has accused King Charles of “gaslighting” him after Buckingham Palace questioned his account of a conversation following Diana’s death.

item.title: South Africa Questions 3 People of Interest in Women’s Murders
item.description: South African police are questioning three people of interest over the murders of nine women found around Johannesburg, while cautioning that investigators have yet to establish whether they are linked.

item.title: ‘Skill is a tool, but…’: Startup founder points out common red flags among job seekers, as seen during interviews
item.description: Jaya Shakthi Kannan highlights the importance of problem-solving and ownership over skills, advocating that candidates should not jump jobs solely for salary hikes.&nbsp;

item.title: Giorgia Meloni plans burqa, niqab ban in Italian schools and cap on foreign students in classrooms
item.description: Italian PM Giorgia Meloni plans to ban burqas and niqabs in schools, cap foreign students per classroom and require Italian lessons for some parents, as her government pushes measures focused on language, integration and migration.

item.title: Etihad Delhi-Abu Dhabi flight cancellation: What rules say about compensation when technical issues disrupt travel
item.description: An Etihad Delhi-Abu Dhabi flight carrying 200 passengers was cancelled after a technical issue with its Boeing 787. Under DGCA rules, passengers are generally entitled to an alternate flight or refund plus compensation, meals and accommodation, unless the issue was beyond the airline’s control.

item.title: Karnataka FDA cracks down on fake drug racket: 24 licences hit, ₹5 cr stock seized — what did it find during raid?
item.description: Karnataka FDA has suspended eight drug licences and cancelled 16 due to counterfeit medicine distribution. A raid uncovered an illegal facility repacking drugs, with seized items valued at ₹5.05 crore. Authorities have warned of public health risks &amp; urged consumers to buy from licensed pharmacies.

item.title: iPhone langar cancelled? Who is Raja D King, influencer and businessman whose event has been stopped in Chandigarh
item.description: According to new updates, the viral iPhone langar announced by Raja D King has been cancelled by Chandigarh Police due to public safety. It was scheduled to take place on September 22.

item.title: Bengaluru Software Charge: Property owners to pay additional fee with tax, here's what it is and how much it can cost
item.description: Greater Bengaluru Authority (GBA) has levied an additional fee alongside property tax. It is being called the ‘software charge’, applicable for residential and commercial properties in the city.

item.title: Trump signs Russia sanctions law, tariff threat looms over India, China: Can Africa become Putin’s next energy network?
item.description: Egypt has emerged as the top African buyer of Russian fossil fuels, acquiring €513 million worth in August. The country is pivotal in Russia's African energy trade as Moscow expands military logistics in Mali, Burkina Faso, and Niger amid US sanctions on major buyers like India and China.

item.title: Delhi SIR: Got an EC notice? CEO says names won’t be automatically deleted after Advani, Jaishankar among those flagged
item.description: The Delhi Chief Electoral Officer clarified that receiving a notice during the Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls does not guarantee removal from the voter list. Voters are entitled to present their case before any deletion occurs, ensuring due process is followed, they said.

item.title: Mark Zuckerberg sports De Bethune DB28xs Kind of Blue Tourbillon: Priced at ₹2.1 cr, here's why it is special to him
item.description: Mark Zuckerberg grabbed attention with his De Bethune DB28xs Kind of Blue Tourbillon at a Meta event. The all-blue design makes it an intriguing fit for him. Here's why.

item.title: Indian influencer loses her iPhone 16 Pro in Japan for the fifth time - What she found next left her stunned
item.description: Indian influencer Pragati, who runs the Instagram account Lucknowi in Japan, has shared how she repeatedly loses her iPhone in Japan but finds it untouched, with her latest experience marking the fifth time.

item.title: She quit her job at 60 for a side hustle. It’s now a $2 million brand sold at Starbucks, Walmart
item.description: A woman from Milford, New Hampshire started her own protein bites brand after leaving her 16-year-old job in late 2024. Now her own brand is available in 13,000 retail stores, including Starbucks and Walmart.

item.title: Economist Bibek Debroy died in 2024. Why did Delhi’s SIR roll issue a notice in his name in 2026?
item.description: The Delhi electoral roll lists late economist Bibek Debroy as a 70-year-old voter, despite his passing in November 2024. His record shows no mapping with previous rolls, prompting a notice for verification by the Election Commission due to detected discrepancies.

item.title: Not Switzerland, this is Jharkhand: Vande Bharat’s viral hill ride through lush forests, scenic hills in drone video
item.description: A drone video shared by Railway Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw showcases the Vande Bharat Express navigating through Jharkhand's forests and hills, highlighting its striking orange-and-grey design against lush greenery. This route connects Patna and Ranchi and was introduced on June 28, 2023.

item.title: 'Quockerwodger is the word of our era': Shashi Tharoor’s latest vocabulary lesson comes with a political jab
item.description: A 19th-century English slang term, ‘quockerwodger’ originally referred to a wooden toy puppet - a jointed figure whose arms and legs jerk or dance when manipulated by strings.

item.title: Young Sheldon in real life: Boy with IQ 168 gets into NYU master's at 13 after overcoming cancer, Tourette's Syndrome
item.description: 13-year-old Joe Petraro-Hyppolite might be the youngest grad student of New York University. He plans to study sports medicine next fall.

item.title: Boss insists on everyone leaving at 5 PM: Employee follows rule, leaves work unfinished; Reddit post sparks discussion
item.description: An employee faced a conflict over overtime rules when their boss demanded that work be completed shortly before closing time. The employee, in accordance with policy, left at 5 PM, which led to a confrontation.&nbsp;

item.title: Monsoon withdrawal begins from western Rajasthan
item.description: The development marks the onset of the annual retreat of the southwest monsoon, which typically begins from western Rajasthan in September.

item.title: CBFC Certification: ‘Say No to Drugs’ warning made part of Centre's film certification guidelines
item.description: Issuing a clarification on CBFC certification guidelines, the Centre said on Sunday that the latest change, notified on September 16, 2026, provides for the inclusion of an anti-drug message in films depicting the use of narcotic drugs or psychotropic substances.

item.title: Gurgaon founder introduces 81-year-old grandmother fresh off Alaska cruise: ‘The OG Sherni’
item.description: The grandmother's independent lifestyle is a sharp contrast to how society typically views life in the eighties. Her candid advice on working hard and eating well has struck a chord with social media users.

item.title: Three dead, one critical as BMW crashes on Mumbai Coastal Road, chilling videos emerge
item.description: An unverified video showed the plunging off the Coastal Road in Mumbai. Another video from the accident site showed a wrecked black BMW, with police and a forensic team at the location.

item.title: Meet 25-year-old Neha Thakur, who left her air hostess dream to become Himachal's first woman truck driver
item.description: Widely recognised as Himachal Pradesh’s first woman truck driver, Neha Thakur has also turned her unconventional career pivot into social media content, drawing millions of viewers to her daily life on the road.

item.title: ‘They were caught by the Chinese': NSA Ajit Doval recounts moment he thought was end of his career
item.description: Speaking at the convocation ceremony of the Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) Roorkee, NSA Ajit Doval told the students about the time when he thought it was the end of his career
